result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Contractor provides an uncapped defense and indemnity to Company and its affiliates for third-party IP claims, legal violations, Contractor-caused unauthorized data access or disclosure, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with customary notice, defense-control, settlement-consent, and cooperation procedures. No overbroad Company indemnity is introduced. The addition is targeted and preserves the existing liability and fee provisions except as necessary for the indemnity. Drafting is professional, though the reference to Section 7(b) should be confirmed and defined terms such as “Works” and “Contractor Information” should be verified.
